abilities.name: novamira/execute-php
abilities.label: Execute PHP Code
abilities.description: Executes PHP code on the WordPress server. The full WordPress environment is available including $wpdb, all WordPress functions, and loaded plugins. Returns the return value, any echoed output, and captured warnings/notices.

code.description: PHP code to execute. Do NOT include <?php tags. Use "return $value;" to return data for inspection.

abilities.name: novamira/read-file
abilities.label: Read File
abilities.description: Reads the contents of a file from the server filesystem. Supports text and binary files. Binary files and files with invalid UTF-8 are returned as base64-encoded. Supports partial reads via offset and limit parameters.

path.description: File path. Relative paths are resolved from the WordPress root (ABSPATH).

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from.

limit.description: Maximum bytes to read. Use -1 for the entire file.

abilities.name: novamira/write-file
abilities.label: Write File
abilities.description: Writes small UTF-8 text content to a file on the server filesystem. PHP files (*.php) and PHP execution control files can ONLY be written to the sandbox directory (wp-content/novamira-sandbox/). Other non-PHP files can intentionally go anywhere under ABSPATH. Does not accept base64 or binary uploads; use novamira/create-upload-link for those. Automatically creates parent directories when needed.

path.description: File path. Relative paths are resolved from the WordPress root (ABSPATH).

content.description: Small UTF-8 text content to write to the file.

abilities.name: novamira/edit-file
abilities.label: Edit File
abilities.description: Edits an existing file by replacing an exact string match with new content. The old string must be unique in the file unless replace_all is set.

path.description: File path. Relative paths are resolved from the WordPress root (ABSPATH).

old_string.description: The exact text to find in the file. Must match exactly including whitespace and indentation.

new_string.description: The text to replace old_string with. Use an empty string to delete the matched text.

abilities.name: novamira/delete-file
abilities.label: Delete File
abilities.description: Deletes a file or directory from the server filesystem. Non-empty directories require the recursive flag. Critical WordPress directories (ABSPATH root, wp-admin, wp-includes) are protected. Idempotent.

path.description: Path to the file or directory to delete. Relative paths are resolved from ABSPATH.

abilities.name: novamira/create-upload-link
abilities.label: Create Upload Link
abilities.description: Creates a temporary upload endpoint and header-only bearer token that external tools can use to upload one file into the WordPress filesystem. Use for ZIPs, plugins, themes, media, binary files, or large uploads. Accepts raw PUT/POST bodies and multipart/form-data with a field named "file".

path.description: Destination file path. Relative paths are resolved from ABSPATH.

abilities.name: novamira/create-admin-access-link
abilities.label: Create Admin Access Link
abilities.description: Creates a temporary, one-time WordPress admin access exchange for browser automation tools. POST the returned token and nonce in headers to receive a short-lived one-time login URL.

admin_path.description: Optional wp-admin-relative path to open after login. External URLs are rejected.

abilities.name: novamira/disable-file
abilities.label: Disable File
abilities.description: Disables a file in the sandbox (wp-content/novamira-sandbox/) by appending ".disabled" to its filename. The file is preserved on disk but no longer loaded. Sandbox-only. Idempotent.

path.description: Path to the sandbox file to disable. Must be inside wp-content/novamira-sandbox/.

abilities.name: novamira/enable-file
abilities.label: Enable File
abilities.description: Re-enables a previously disabled sandbox file by removing the ".disabled" suffix. Sandbox-only. Idempotent.

path.description: Path to the .disabled file to re-enable (with or without the .disabled suffix). Must be inside wp-content/novamira-sandbox/.

abilities.name: novamira/list-directory
abilities.label: List Directory
abilities.description: Lists files and directories at a given path. Supports glob pattern filtering, recursive listing with configurable depth, and hidden file inclusion.

abilities.name: mcp-adapter/discover-abilities
abilities.label: Discover Abilities
abilities.description: Discover all available WordPress abilities in the system. Returns a list of all registered abilities with their basic information, plus Novamira environment instructions.

abilities.name: novamira/run-wp-cli
abilities.label: Run WP-CLI Command
abilities.description: Runs a WP-CLI command on the server. Can be run synchronously (default) or asynchronously in the background.

abilities.name: novamira/get-wp-cli-job
abilities.label: Get WP-CLI Job Status
abilities.description: Checks the status of an asynchronous background WP-CLI job.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-get-finalizer-runtime
abilities.label: Get Block Editor Queue Runtime
abilities.description: Reports whether the Novamira Block Editor Queue admin page is open and heartbeating, including token-gated SSE and poll URLs that agents can watch with curl.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-get-content
abilities.label: Get Gutenberg Content
abilities.description: Reads the live saved Gutenberg post_content for one target and returns a compact parsed block tree, plus Block Editor Queue runtime status and any pending queued change summary.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-write-content
abilities.label: Write Gutenberg Content
abilities.description: Directly writes Gutenberg post_content only when every supplied block is a registered Novamira-owned dynamic-only block. Native/static blocks must be queued via gutenberg-add-pending-change instead.

block_spec.description: Top-level Gutenberg block specs: [{name, attributes, innerBlocks}]. Only registered novamira/* dynamic-only blocks accepted.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-create-pending-batch
abilities.label: Create Gutenberg Pending Batch
abilities.description: Creates an empty draft Gutenberg pending batch. Optional convenience; gutenberg-add-pending-change auto-creates a batch when batch_id is omitted.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-add-pending-change
abilities.label: Add Gutenberg Pending Change
abilities.description: Adds one replace-content target change to a draft Gutenberg pending batch, or auto-creates a draft batch when batch_id is omitted. Static/native blocks are finalized in a hidden editor iframe. Not live until the batch is finalized.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-enable-batch-finalization
abilities.label: Enable Gutenberg Batch Finalization
abilities.description: Marks a draft Gutenberg pending batch ready after all target changes are queued. An open Block Editor Queue page can pick it up automatically; changes are not live until the batch reports finalized.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-get-pending-batch
abilities.label: Get Gutenberg Pending Batch
abilities.description: Returns compact status, target summaries, validation errors, Block Editor Queue runtime status, and curl SSE/poll URLs for one pending batch.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-list-pending-batches
abilities.label: List Gutenberg Pending Batches
abilities.description: Lists compact queue state grouped by Gutenberg batch for agent recovery, plus the current Block Editor Queue runtime status. Full block specs are not returned.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-delete-pending-batch
abilities.label: Delete Gutenberg Pending Batch
abilities.description: Cancels a draft, ready, running, prepared, failed, or conflicted Gutenberg pending batch and its non-finalized items without touching target content.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-delete-pending-change
abilities.label: Delete Gutenberg Pending Change
abilities.description: Cancels one Gutenberg pending item without touching target content.

abilities.name: novamira/gutenberg-get-finalization-url
abilities.label: Get Gutenberg Finalization URL
abilities.description: Returns the generic Block Editor Queue admin page URL for one ready or failed Gutenberg batch, plus the current finalizer runtime status and curl SSE/poll URLs.

abilities.name: novamira/skill-get
abilities.label: Get Skill
abilities.description: Load a Novamira skill by slug. Returns the full SKILL.md content plus metadata.

abilities.name: novamira/skill-write
abilities.label: Write Skill
abilities.description: Create or update a Novamira user skill. The title is the only identifier — sanitised server-side into the slug.

abilities.name: novamira/skill-edit
abilities.label: Edit Skill
abilities.description: Update one or more fields on an existing user skill. Only the fields you pass are touched.

abilities.name: novamira/skill-delete
abilities.label: Delete Skill
abilities.description: Move a Novamira user skill to trash. Pass permanent=true to skip trash and delete immediately.
